title: US 31 Kokomo Bypass Concrete Patch Job (R-43541)
description: Worked on a 13-mile concrete patching job around Kokomo, IN, across two E&B Paving internships. In 2025, helped pour the patches and tine the concrete in the field. In 2026, developed job cost breakdowns for INDOT, built forecasting spreadsheets and monitored resource allocation.

title: EPICS NABL - Wheelchair Training Platform
description: Led a multidisciplinary Purdue EPICS team in designing and completing a wheelchair training platform for new employees at Grant's House in Lafayette, IN. Took over the project midway through its lifecycle and completed it by the end of the semester. Grant's House now uses it to train new hires.
imageAlt: Brayden and the EPICS team standing behind the completed wheelchair training platform

title: 2025 Fall Undergraduate Research Expo - Predicting Diabetes Risk
description: Earned the Distinction Award at the 2025 Fall Undergraduate Research Expo for research applying machine learning to predict diabetes risk among Pima Indian women, identifying glucose, BMI and age as key predictors.
imageAlt: Brayden and fellow researchers in front of their research poster at the 2025 Fall Undergraduate Research Expo
